Fix duplicates. Need basic smart playlists. Need mobile lyric page view. Need lyrics cast to TV — 2026 Update: Fix duplicates. Can they be linked? There are so many duplicates of songs. So many. Not talking about 10th anniversary versions or single versions but those exist too. Each of these are linked to a different copy of the standard album. These are not singles, not extended versions, not an anniversary edition, not a greatest hit version, not an acoustic version, just the same song. This clogs my library. Terrible redundancy. Messes up with shuffling into the same song multiple times. A significant amount of my library would be fixed with this. This also takes more storage on my phone when I want to download my saved songs from an artist. I also dislike when I save a song from the original album then the artwork gets switched to a random compilation album. of the song and instead of the original artwork and details it shows up as ‘run dance compilation’ with some random artwork. Easily my most frustrating thing with Spotify. We need smart playlists. I don’t know why I need to manually add my favorite songs released in 2026 onto a playlist, when I could build that into a playlist then those songs get added automatically when I save them into my library. Need a fixed lyric page on mobile. Way frustrating to manually scroll and click for lyrics each time. Dream would be to be able to cast lyrics to a TV with karaoke style.
